sap.app.title: Semantic Page using Draft Indicator
sap.app.description: A sap.f.semantic.SemanticPage with a DraftIndicator (state Saved) in the draftIndicator slot, MessagesIndicator in the messagesIndicator slot, and ShareMenu actions (DiscussInJam, SaveAsTile, SendEmail, SendMessage); demonstrates draft-workflow integration on a SemanticPage.
